text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City Policy or by-laws. PCL Constructors is constructing a 22-storey building for institutional use at 175 Elizabeth Street, also commonly known as "Sick Kids Patient Support Centre". The site is bounded by Walton Street to the north, industrial use building - 85 Walton Street, a research and education building - 72-78 Elm Street and 675 Bay Street - to the east, Elm Street to the south and Elizabeth Street to the west. Transportation Services is requesting approval to close the east sidewalk and a portion of the northbound lane on Elizabeth Street and the north sidewalk and a portion of the westbound lane on Elm Street for a period of 41 months to accommodate construction staging areas.
